name: quint

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: Quint formal specification tool for temporal-flow model checking and model-based test artifact generation
installHint: Installed via `npm install --prefix ~/.cache/vrooli/formal-tools/quint/node @informalsystems/quint@0.32.0` then symlinked to ~/.local/bin/quint. Requires Node/npm on PATH and Java 17+ for `quint verify`.
notes: Pinned for deterministic formal-model validation; bump with generated temporal-flow artifacts.
